opinions.text: Motion of the Special Master for interim fees and expenses granted, and the Special Master is awarded $92,240.78 to be paid as follows: 40% by Kansas, 40% by Colorado, and 20% by the United States. Report of the Special Master received and ordered filed. Exceptions to the Report, with supporting briefs, may be filed by the parties within 45 days. Reply briefs, if any, may be filed by the parties within 30 days. [For earlier order herein, see, e. g., 510 U. S. 1174.]
